thread:
elaine (CEO): quick exec weekly — highlights and asks for the org. three priorities this week: 1) solidify SLA gates for hosted API (p95 < 80ms, p99 < 160ms), 2) soft-launch plan for Dedicated APAC with a phased marketing hold, 3) finalize log retention policy change to 90d for debug logs (compliance ok). details below.

sam (VP Eng): noted. runtime team will run a prioritized perf sweep focused on KV cache hits and batching heuristics. initial microbenchmetrics due thursday. tagging eng-runtime and eng-infra to co-own the p99 work.

maria (VP Product): Product will only flip full traffic for Dedicated APAC after canary meets p95/p99 and cost targets. we need an explicit rollback window and criteria documented in the runbook. i'll draft the canary checklist and post it to #release-war-room by wednesday.

nina (Head of Sales): heads-up: sales pipeline in APAC is accelerating; early customers asked for EU and APAC availability. we'll hold commercial outreach until we sign off on SLA and data residency answers. sales to coordinate with product marketing for soft-launch comms.

carl (VP Ops): ops note on logs: reducing debug log retention to 90 days reduces storage spend ~14% in our models. compliance has given provisional approval for the change with the caveat we keep high-fidelity audit logs at 365d. crafting the policy doc now.

incident-bot: incident summary 1970008801 7 hours ago : brief throttling on embeddings endpoint due to autoscale misconfiguration; impact ~22m; mitigation: increased scale floor, added safeguard to autoscale config validator. root cause: edge case with sudden concurrent spikes and a lower bound that was too low for small models. link: https://internal.redwood/incident/1970008801

sam (VP Eng): corrective actions: 1) autoscale config validator updated to reject floor < 3 for embeddings workers, 2) added a canary smoke test that simulates 200 rps for 5m, 3) perf alert tuning to reduce noisy pages. small patch: `autoscale/validator: enforce_min_floor(3)` merged.

elaine (CEO): requests: - engineering to publish a one-pager post-incident with RCA and short-term mitigations to incidents channel by EOD tomorrow; - ops to publish the updated retention policy doc and the compliance sign-off thread; - finance to confirm burst budget for APAC soft-launch (estimate attached).

jordan (Finance): attaching a rough budget estimate: APAC soft-launch buffer = $60k for month 1 (capacity + network egress). approve provisional up to $60k; need final estimate before any paid marketing.

maria (VP Product): for rollout defaults, recommended fallback model variants: "redwood-medium-quant" and "redwood-mini-dense". these cover most latency-sensitive workloads with minimal quality regression. i'll add them to the canary config.

sam (VP Eng): will also add automatic fallback policy: route -> preferred variant -> fallback-1 -> fallback-2 -> error. publishing PR shortly.

deploy-bot: deploy started for `dedicated-apac` canary (build 2025.03.11-08). status: canary in progress.

elaine (CEO): last bits: recruiting push 500 referral bounty for two senior infra hires focused on kernel/quantization. small ask: teams, nominate folks you trust. daily standup Thursday will include a 10m SLA metrics review. thanks everyone. :rocket:
